    cnt = {}

    cnt = defaultdict(int)
    ans = 0
    c = 0
    s = 0
    for r,x in enumerate(nums):
        cnt[x] += 1
        if cnt[x] == 1: c += 1
        s += x
        if r >= k:
            y = nums[r-k]
            cnt[y] -= 1
            if cnt[y] == 0: c -= 1
            s -= y
        if c >= m: ans = max(ans,s)
    return ans
